_comment: Ground truth from the Scala reference stack (sigma-state 6.0.2 + ergo-core 6.0.2).
Pins EVERY EvaluatedValue form the reference accepts as a stored value in a box
register and in a ContextExtension entry, on both the serde and the reduce surfaces.
`EvaluatedValue` is a SEALED trait (sigma/ast/values.scala:310) with four subclasses:
Constant (:331), EvaluatedCollection/ConcreteCollection (:589), GroupGenerator (:709)
and Tuple (:779). Both ContextExtension.serializer.parse (ContextExtension.scala:59)
and ErgoBoxCandidate.serializer (ErgoBoxCandidate.scala:231) read entries with
r.getValue().asInstanceOf[EvaluatedValue[_ <: SType]] -- the full ValueSerializer --
and rule 1019 CheckV6Type (ValidationRules.scala:186-192) matches on exactly those
four cases with the message 'V6 type used in register or context var extension'.
Note the two directions of byte handling. 0x82 / 0x83 / 0x85 / 0x86 are PRESERVED:
the reference keeps the parsed node and re-emits the same form. 0x7f (TrueLeaf) and
0x80 (FalseLeaf) are CANONICALIZED: ValueSerializer.deserialize accepts the bare
opcode via CaseObjectSerialization (ValueSerializer.scala:79-80) but serialize routes
the ConstantNode[SBoolean] (values.scala:742, :753) back through ConstantSerializer,
so they come out as 0101 / 0100. A non-canonical Boolean payload (0105) canonicalizes
the same way. A box id is blake2b256 of the STRUCTURALLY re-serialized box bytes, so
an implementation must reproduce both directions or it computes a different id than
the reference for a box the reference accepts.

box_prefix._comment: ErgoBoxCandidate: 1000000 nanoERG, script sigmaProp(true), height 0, no tokens, one register. Append the register hex to get the full candidate.
box_prefix.box_suffix_comment: transactionId 0x07..07 (32 bytes) + output index 3; box id = blake2b256(candidate_bytes || suffix)

forms.name: bool_collection
forms._comment: values.scala:845 -- ConcreteCollection.apply routes an all-boolean-constant collection to this node unconditionally, so 0x85 is the only wire form such a node takes.

forms.name: true_leaf_opcode
forms.node: TrueLeaf (0x7f) -- accepted on input, CANONICALIZED on output
forms.box_id_comment: computed over the CANONICAL 0101 register form, not over the 7f wire byte

forms.name: false_leaf_opcode
forms.node: FalseLeaf (0x80) -- accepted on input, CANONICALIZED on output

forms.name: bool_constant_noncanonical
forms.node: Constant[SBoolean] with a non-0x01 payload (0105) -- CANONICALIZED

forms.name: bool_constant_true
forms.node: Constant[SBoolean] true (0101) -- the canonical target form

forms.name: group_element_constant_control
forms.node: Constant[SGroupElement] holding the generator -- the value-equivalent control for GroupGenerator

not_an_evaluated_value._comment: Height is a NotReadyValue, so the asInstanceOf checkcast throws. Pins the boundary: the permissive reader must not become 'accept any expression'.
not_an_evaluated_value.scala_message: class sigma.ast.Height$ cannot be cast to class sigma.ast.EvaluatedValue

_comment: sigma-state 6.0.2 has NO `k < 0` guard in ContextExtension.serializer.parse (that
check exists only in later revisions), so a key byte with the high bit set parses
and lands as a negative Scala Byte. The rejection happens at context build:
ErgoLikeContext.toSigmaContext sizes the var array from keys.max.

reduce._comment: CErgoTreeEvaluator.eval against the dummy ErgoLikeContext (activated version 3, SELF = the tree at 1000000 nanoERG as the sole input). P:d3 = TrivialProp(true), P:d2 = TrivialProp(false).

group_element_constant_register_control._comment: Same script, R4 = Constant[SGroupElement](generator). Identical verdict AND cost -- node and constant are value-equivalent; only the bytes differ.
